resources.string: Open the app to solve the captcha and connect through TURN.

Tunnels proxy traffic through a VK Calls relay before it reaches the server, so the connection looks like an ordinary call. Auto probes the network first and only tunnels when the direct path is blocked. Holding the power button for two seconds connects through TURN once, whatever the mode.
Using the link from your subscription: %1$s
No link was delivered with your subscription. Paste one here — TURN stays inactive without it.
This link overrides the one delivered with your subscription.
The relay serves up to %1$d peers per VK account. Only when it is full does the app sign in with one more account — which may ask for one more captcha.
Counts appear once the VPN is connected and a relay is in use.
Per relay: sessions / open streams, then VK accounts in use.
VK sometimes asks for a captcha before the relay will accept a call. The prompt opens on its own when one is waiting; use this to reopen it.
Add or refresh a subscription that advertises TURN relays.
Only servers your subscription marks as supported are tunnelled; the rest connect directly.
